head: 8467f01
summary: 8.6, up from 8.5 at 1430d42. Nothing high or medium is open. PY geometry, proportion and materials are frozen: src/09b_py.js and the PY SEATMAT keys are unchanged, and studio views p1-p8 are pixel-identical to 1430d42 (0 changed px). Silhouette, shell, ears, console and the q13 row pitch therefore read exactly as they did in the final round. The lighting final touch fixed the routed cool-cast item, and it did so at constant luminance. On the q14 mid back, B/R went from 1.390 to 1.297 at L 124.5 -> 124.4. On the q13 front back, B/R went from 1.492 to 1.379 at L 109.2 -> 109.0. The photo py_37301 measures 1.26 on the back and 1.21 on the cushion. The fabric now reads blue-grey rather than periwinkle. q13 is still at the cool end of the photo range, which is low severity. Diffing old against head shows no new artefacts on the PY seats. In q14 only 2,854 px change by more than 15 L, all at y 53-182 on the window reveals and the sidewall above the seats, and they get brighter. In q13, 349 px change, all at x < 100 on the far-left sidewall. Fabric contrast, thin-dark detail and the seam bead are all unchanged within 1 L. The low diamond sun patch on the window-seat back has not changed (L 178.7 in both). The +0.1 is for the colour: the fabric hue is back on the photo. The w17/w15 low carry-overs (cushion-front band, ears, pocket frame, orange-peel) hold the score below 9.
lighting_note: Not scored. (1) The cool-cast fix works. Fabric (B-R)/L is 0.273 in q14 (target about 0.25; photo back 0.24) and 0.342 in q13 (photo 0.19-0.24). q13 is still a little cool: B/R 1.38 against the photo's 1.22-1.36. If the lighting owner does another pass, trimming the q13 front-row seat-level tint by about 5 % would land it in range. That is optional. (2) The diamond-shaped sun patch on the q14 window-seat back (x 485-550, y 300-420) is unchanged: mean L 178.7, sd 50.8, max 249. py_37301 and py_37303 show evenly lit seat backs, so this stays low. (3) The q14 window reveals above the seats got about 16 L brighter (y 140-210, x 480-720). That is a sidewall/lighting matter and neutral for PY. (4) The rendered fabric is still darker than the photo, L 124 against about 154.
